segments.text: ALmightie and euerlaſting God, which hateſt nothing that thou haſte made, and doeſt forgeue the ſynnes of al them that be penitent: Create and make in vs newe and contrite heartes, that we worthely lamenting our ſynnes, and knowlegyng oure wretchednes, may obtayne of thee, the God of all mercy, perfecte remiſſion and forgeueneſſe, through Ieſus Chriſte.
